title: Registered owner's responsibility for a summons or citation.
bodyText: In any proceeding for a violation of this chapter, the information contained in the summons or citation, mailed in accordance with section 291J-6, shall be deemed prima facie evidence that a violation of section 291C-32(c) occurred. The registered owner shall be strictly liable for a violation of section 291C-32(c).
bodyHtml: §291J-7  Registered owner's responsibility for a summons or citation.  In any proceeding for a violation of this chapter, the information contained in the summons or citation, mailed in accordance with section 291J-6, shall be deemed prima facie evidence that a violation of section 291C-32(c) occurred.  The registered owner shall be strictly liable for a violation of section 291C-32(c). [L 2020, c 30, pt of §2; am L 2022, c 124, §6]
